我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实信徒，我们来自遥远的宇宙，为你献上最为神圣的商品。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and we have come in service of Numa, the goddess of fortune, bearing most holy merchandise from distant corners of the galaxy.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！财运之风最终将我带到了你美丽的地盘。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实仆人，我们为你带来了受到女神祝福的货物。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
Ah, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Finally the winds of fortune have brought us to your bountiful lands. We are the Numistic Order, faithful servants of the goddess Numa, and we have come to offer you her blessed wares.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
日安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，我们带来了财富女神奴玛所庇佑过的神圣货物。她一直向我们耳边呢喃，言道遥远的[Root.Capital.GetStarName]存在着一个独立的文明，齐心协力我们可成就无上的奇迹。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and our wares bear the holy seal of Numa, goddess of fortune. She has long whispered of a distant civilization around [Root.Capital.GetStarName] and the wonders we could achieve together.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！神圣的旨意将我们带到你的土地，我们为你们带来了许多神奇的事物。我们是拜金教团，我们的交易从来都不是为了我们自己，而是听从财富女神的旨意。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Divine intervention has brought us to your lands carrying many wondrous things. We are the Numistic Order, and our deals have been forged by the goddess of fortune herself.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
没想到这一切都是真的，你们真如女神奴玛所预言的一样繁荣。常言道，财富只会眷顾勇者。

我们是拜金教团，一群单纯的商人，将自己的全部身心奉献给财富女神。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
texts.en:
But it is true! You really are as prosperous as Numa has foretold. Fortune favors the bold as they say.

We are the Numistic Order, simple merchants, devoted to the worship of commerce.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地，让我们每次进入时都能提供新的交易。

遗憾的是，目前我们的舰船全部位于你的领地之外。不过下一次我们访问你们宇域的时候，只需一点点捐赠。整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。
texts.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

Sadly, our ships are beyond the bounds of your realm for the moment, but next time we visit your skies, the wonders of the universe could be yours for a modest donation of credits...

label.zh: 在[Root.GetName]边境内必然有一支[caravaneer_fleet2_country.GetName]的舰队。
label.en: The [caravaneer_fleet2_country.GetName] must have a fleet within the [Root.GetName]'s borders.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗恒星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the star's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你们的种族称呼。
note.en: In the game, a term for your people appears here.

texts.zh:
你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。

奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.

Numa has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine that could bring you prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
把 [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName] 带上来。在我们穿越星系的朝圣之路中，我们拯救了许多迷失的魂灵……

看看这优秀的物种，它们接受了拜金管理之道的熏陶。看到它[fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]深处了吗？这颜色表明它是一个十分健康的个体。他们同样十分胜任体力活。而且他们的繁殖能力十分出色。你觉得如何？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Bring in the [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName]. During our pilgrimage across the galaxy we have saved many lost souls...

Look at this fine specimen, schooled in the art of Numistic administration. See the inside of his [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]? That color there indicates a healthy individual. They make great laborers too. And their reproductive capacities are astounding. What say you?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
关闭你的影像接收器，想象你正漂浮在能量币的洪流之中，而你即将抵达的，是一座满溢着更多能量币的山峰。

有了我们拜金教的成像技术，你很快就会明白，意志之力凌驾于世间任何力量。能量币将如同往低处流的水一样自然的涌向你，而你将永远地从物欲中解放出来。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Close your visual receptors. Now picture yourself on your back floating on a stream of energy credits towards a mountain of even more energy credits.

With our Numistic visualization techniques you will learn that there is no greater power than the power of the mind. You too will be free of material desires and credits will be drawn to you like arthropoids to dung.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
能量之流的图案……它们存在于各处，但无人可视。奴玛自己便可预测这神圣之潮和整个股票市场的流动。只要你愿献出一点点捐助，我们就将把她无穷智慧中的一角传授于你。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Patterns in the energy flow... They are everywhere yet no one sees. Numa alone can predict the divine ebb and flow of the stock market. And for a small donation, we will share some of her wisdom with you.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
请允许我们引见我们最棒的一个精神领袖，拥有强大思维能力同时能够看穿一切的九阶沙克瓦。在女神的指引下，你的生意将会繁荣昌盛。

而我们只希望你能提供小小的捐助……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
May we present one of our finest spiritual leaders, a level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze. Under the goddess' guidance, business on your worlds will flourish.

All we ask is a small donation in credits...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将向你提供一个特别的交易……奴玛认为你的人民很有潜力，并且欢迎一部分你的子民为奴玛效忠。她将奉上无价的水晶作为回报……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we have a very special offer for you... Numa has seen great potential in your people and would like to welcome some of your kind into her ranks. In return these priceless crystals could be yours...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
这是财富之恩惠号，我们最受信任的警戒舰……她被女神亲自选中，在星系中护送我们受祝福的货物，并曾经击退过许多渎神者——海盗、异端、虚空怪物，以及任何阻碍奴玛的神圣之道的人！如今，她仍旧几乎完好如新……

是的，她曾尽心为财富服务，而现在只需一点微不足道的捐赠，她也可以为你服务……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Behold Fortune's Favor, our most trusted guard ship... She was chosen by the goddess herself to escort our blessed cargo across the galaxy and has thwarted many a blasphemer in her day - pirates, infidels, monsters of the void, all who interfere with Numa's divine path! Yet she is almost as good as new...

Yes, she has served fortune well and now, for a modest donation, she may also serve you...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
请原谅我们的冒犯，但我们注意到你的星球，[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]，拥有一种尚未被发掘的独特潜力。我们可以打开一道通往其神圣地心的裂口，财富就将源源不断地从中涌出！

让我们揭露你星球上隐藏的秘密吧。当然了，我们需要一笔象征性的酬劳。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Forgive us our intrusiveness, but we have noticed your planet, [fleet2deal8planet.GetName], possesses a unique potential not currently being realized. A vent can be opened to its sacred core, from whence the flow of wealth can trickle forth!

Let us reveal to you the hidden secrets of your land. We will require a nominal remuneration, of course.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
愿神圣的女神奴玛保佑你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。她向我们展示了如何将你的单元更好地与[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]的磁场进行同调。有了我们神圣而且专利注册的拜金教磁条，你在[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]上的无人机将减缓对£energy£ 能量币的依赖。

作为交换，我们希望能在你的土地上举办一场献神的仪式。你意向如何？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
The Divine Numa smiles on you this day, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. She has shown us how to better align your units to [fleet2deal9planet.GetName]'s magnetosphere. With our holy, patented Numistic Magnetostrips, your drones on [fleet2deal9planet.GetName] will drain your sacred £energy£ Energy Credits with less fervor.

In exchange, we require a ceremony to the Divine be hosted on your soil. What say you?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
我们的一位传教士在冥想之中被奴玛降临在她身上，迅速而含糊地说出了女神的旨意。尽管这位传教士并未活过这场考验，但我们解析了她话语中的含义，得到了一种能将一和零变为百万的算法。

不要令她的牺牲白费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。将财富引入你们的地核，她就不会抛弃你们。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
Deep in a meditative trance, one of our ecclesiasts gave herself over to Numa and spoke the goddess' sacred truth in a rapid stream of glossolalia. Though the ecclesiast herself did not survive her trial, we deciphered from her utterances an algorithm that can turn ones and zeros into millions.

Do not let her sacrifice be in vain, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Invite fortune into your planetary core and she will not desert you.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

texts.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

答案是……另一艘警戒舰，对吧？
texts.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

It is... another guard ship, is it not?

texts.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

答案是……异星天然气，不对么？嗯……真是令人陶醉的芳香！那是成功的气息！深吸一口气，你就能亲眼目睹奴玛的庄容。但是要小心，过量吸入可能会损害你的隔膜。
texts.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

It's... exotic gases, is it not? Mm... and what a lovely scent they have! It is the smell of success! A deep breath of these and you will see Numa in the flesh. But be advised, excessive inhalation may dry out your membranes.

texts.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

当然了！答案是……能量币……一直都是能量币。钱币能扭转乾坤。在你的问题上抛洒钱币，你的问题就会不见了。赞美奴玛！
texts.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

But of course! It's... credits... always credits. Credits make the world go round. We will throw credits at your problem and your problem will disappear. Praise Numa!

texts.zh:
通过奴玛的指导，我们发现这些古代文物对我们的冥想很有启发性。

与它们分离的想法当然让我们感到痛苦，但我们认为你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以通过研究它们获得很多知识。

我们需要一些高级物资，所以或许我们可以进行一个交易……？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
texts.en:
By the guiding hand of Numa, we have come across these ancient artifacts which have been very inspiring for our meditations.

The thought of parting with them of course pains us, but we feel that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could learn much by studying them.

We are in need of some advanced materials, so perhaps a deal could be made..?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

responses.zh: 祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。
responses.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.

label.en: Not right now. Please get back to us later.

responses.zh: 那好吧，[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们会在离开你的领地时再次联系你。但是请注意，奴玛可是一位多变的女士。如果她改变了主意，那么我们的交易可能会发生改变……
responses.en: As you wish, [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will contact you again before we leave. But bear in mind, Numa is a fickle mistress. If her mind sways, the deal may change...

label.zh: 选“以后再说”后，这支车队下次穿越国境时的最后一次报价（间隔至少360天）
label.en: After choosing "get back to us later": the last offer when the fleet next crosses the border (at least 360 days apart)

title.zh: 行商舰队：拜金教团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order: Last Call

texts.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
texts.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

texts.zh: 奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！
texts.en: Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

texts.zh:
往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。

命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。
texts.en:
It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.

Fate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

texts.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？

好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？
texts.en:
Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?

Weigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

responses.zh: 祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。
responses.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你们的种族称呼。
note.en: In the game, a term for your people appears here.

texts.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告财富之风已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的拉奇行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
texts.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Winds of Fortune has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, this star system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：本国舰队歼灭这支车队时（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）弹出，给舰队指挥官添加特质，并通知其他帝国（cara.2003）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the empire's fleet destroys this caravan (on_fleet_destroyed_perp); it gives the fleet's leader a trait and notifies other empires (cara.2003).

texts.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说财富之风已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的拜金教商人行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
texts.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Winds of Fortune is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Merchant of Numa caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.

An unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
texts.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

texts.zh: 跟随能量币的脚步，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，它将指引你通往真相。没有什么货物能比承载着奴玛意志的货物更加神圣了……
texts.en: Follow the current of cosmic energy credits, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it will take you to the truth. There is no better product than that which carries the holy seal of Numa...

texts.zh: 奴玛，在财富流动之时微笑。
texts.en: When credits pass hands, Numa smiles.

texts.zh:
你把那叫做公平！？你简直就是侮辱奴玛！

哦，有客人来了！很抱歉让你看到刚才那一幕。刚才的一幕很好的证明了有些人就是不配发财。
texts.en:
You call that a fair deal!? You spit in the face of Numa - pah!

Oh, but we have customers! Our sincerest apologies for that display. Some do not have the courage to accept good fortune when it falls into their lap.

texts.zh: 许多上好的货物流转到我们手中，但是我们从来不会保留这些东西。这是我们的牺牲，为了泰莎塔尔的最终建成，也为了我们的后裔能再次见到圣地。
texts.en: Many wondrous things pass through our hands, yet we never line our pockets. It is the sacrifice we make so that the construction of the Tessar Tarvil is completed and our children may one day see the holy land again.

label.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

summary.text:
# 行商舰队：拜金教团 / Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/caravaneer_events.txt:1995-2800`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1114-1117,1656`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

这支车队（The Numistic Order）在银河中依次访问若干个国家的首都（视银河国家数量定1–10个，cara.2000）；穿越他国国境时触发交易菜单 cara.2100；初次接触（first_contact 的结束阶段）时弹出自我介绍 cara.2020。

The caravan fleet (The Numistic Order) tours the capitals of a number of empires (1–10 depending on the number of empires, cara.2000); crossing a border triggers the trade menu cara.2100; at the end of first contact the introduction cara.2020 shows.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cara.2020（初次接触）或 cara.2100（穿越国境）→ cara.2200 交易：每次现生成一份交易（cara_generate_deal2），可以成交、选“以后再说”或拒绝。选“以后再说”→ 这支车队下次穿越国境时发出 cara.2251“最后一次机会”。

cara.2020 (first contact) or cara.2100 (border crossing) -> cara.2200 the deal: a fresh deal is generated each time (cara_generate_deal2) and can be taken, postponed or refused. Postponing -> the next time this fleet crosses a border it offers cara.2251 "last call".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

成交 / 以后再说 / 拒绝或退出；本国歼灭车队则走 cara.2002 / cara.2003（通知）。

Take the deal / later / refuse or leave; destroying the fleet leads to cara.2002 / cara.2003 (notices).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

交易内容和价格由脚本本地化 GetFleet2DealProduct / Cost 现场决定；嗜杀帝国只有“去死”式退出。

Deal product and cost are produced by the scripted localisation GetFleet2DealProduct / Cost; homicidal empires only get the "Die..." exit.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了行程、国境触发、首次接触入口、最后一次报价与被歼灭处理；三支车队的脚本逐行相同，仅数字不同。原先分开的3张卡（2002、2020、2250）并入本故事。

Route, border trigger, first-contact entry, last offer and destruction handling were checked; the three fleets use identical scripts with different numbers. The former three cards (2002, 2020, 2250) are merged here.
